Loading Eucalypt occurrences
```{r}
library(sp)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

eucalypt_occ <- read.csv("data/euc_coords.csv", header=T)
eucalypt_occ <- eucalypt_occ %>% drop_na()

coords <- cbind(eucalypt_occ$decimalLongitude, eucalypt_occ$decimalLatitude)

euc_sp <- SpatialPoints(coords, proj4string=CRS("+init=epsg:4326"))

```


Loading precipitation rasters from worldclim
```{r}
library(raster)

MAP <- raster("data/MAP.tif")
MAT <- raster("data/MAT.tif")
seasonality <- raster("data/seasonality.tif")
wet_quarter <- raster("data/wet_quarter.tif")
dry_quarter <- raster("data/dry_quarter.tif")
```


Extracting climate data from points
```{r}
eucalypt_occ$MAP <- raster::extract(MAP, euc_sp, method='simple')
eucalypt_occ$MAT <- raster::extract(MAT, euc_sp, method='simple')
eucalypt_occ$seasonality <- raster::extract(seasonality, euc_sp, method='simple')
eucalypt_occ$wet_quarter <- raster::extract(wet_quarter, euc_sp, method='simple')
eucalypt_occ$dry_quarter <- raster::extract(dry_quarter, euc_sp, method='simple')

eucalypt_occ <- eucalypt_occ %>% drop_na()

eucalypt_sum <- eucalypt_occ %>% 
  group_by(scientificName) %>% 
  summarise(MAP=mean(MAP, na.rm=T), 
            MAT=mean(MAT, na.rm=T),
            seasonality=mean(seasonality, na.rm=T),
            wet_quarter=mean(wet_quarter, na.rm=T),
            dry_quarter=mean(dry_quarter, na.rm=T))
```

Filtering species in database
```{r}
euc_database <- read.csv("data/name_matched_list.csv", header=T)


climate_prefs <- eucalypt_sum %>% filter(scientificName %in% euc_database$current_name)
```

Importing xylem data
```{r}
areas <- read.csv("data/xylem_areas.csv", header=T)

xylem_only <- areas %>% filter(Name=="vessel")

xylem_only <- xylem_only %>% 
  separate(Image, c("family", "other"), sep = " ", extra = "merge") %>% 
  separate(other, c("species", "other"), sep = "_", extra = "merge")

xylem_database <- xylem_only %>% 
  left_join(euc_database, by = "species") %>% 
  left_join(climate_prefs, by = c("current_name" = "scientificName")) %>% 
  drop_na(current_name)

sample_counts <- xylem_database %>% group_by(species, other) %>% summarise(n = n())
vessel_counts <- xylem_database %>% group_by(species) %>% summarise(n = n())

species_sum <- xylem_database %>% 
  group_by(species) %>% 
  summarise(mean_area=mean(Area.µm.2, na.rm=T))

```

Adding to climate pref data
```{r}
species_sum <- species_sum %>% 
  left_join(euc_database, by = "species") %>% 
  left_join(climate_prefs, by = c("current_name" = "scientificName"))

species_sum <- species_sum %>% 
  group_by(current_name) %>% 
  summarise(MAP=mean(MAP, na.rm=T), 
            MAT=mean(MAT, na.rm=T),
            seasonality=mean(seasonality, na.rm=T),
            wet_quarter=mean(wet_quarter, na.rm=T),
            dry_quarter=mean(dry_quarter, na.rm=T),
            mean_area=mean(mean_area, na.rm=T)) %>% 
  drop_na()
```

Plotting area to climate variables
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

MAP_plot <- ggplot(species_sum, aes(x=mean_area, y=MAP)) + geom_point()
MAT_plot <- ggplot(species_sum, aes(x=mean_area, y=MAT)) + geom_point()
seasonality_plot <- ggplot(species_sum, aes(x=mean_area, y=seasonality)) + geom_point() + scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10()
wetq_plot <- ggplot(species_sum, aes(x=mean_area, y=wet_quarter)) + geom_point()
dryq_plot <- ggplot(species_sum, aes(x=mean_area, y=dry_quarter)) + geom_point()

MAP_plot + MAT_plot
wetq_plot + dryq_plot
seasonality_plot
```

Data transform
```{r}
species_sum$log_area <- log(species_sum$mean_area)
species_sum$log_MAP <- log(species_sum$MAP)
species_sum$log_wetq <- log(species_sum$wet_quarter)

ggplot(species_sum, aes(x=log_area, y=log_MAP)) + geom_point()
logMAP_plot <- ggplot(species_sum, aes(x=log_area, y=log_MAP)) + geom_point()
logWetq_plot <- ggplot(species_sum, aes(x=log_area, y=log_wetq)) + geom_point()

logMAP_plot + logWetq_plot

MAP_lm <- lm(log_MAP~log_area, data = species_sum)
summary(MAP_lm)
plot(MAP_lm, which=1)

Wetq_lm <- lm(log_wetq~log_area, data = species_sum)
summary(Wetq_lm)
plot(Wetq_lm, which=1)
```
